title: Agent question cap = open agent questions per idea
rationale: roots ask refuses when open+snoozed agent:* questions on the idea >= limits.questionsPerSession; checked inside the questions.jsonl lock (addQuestions validate hook) so concurrent asks cannot overshoot. Dedup is by normalized text against open/snoozed/dismissed questions (dismissals are permanent memory). think runs agent.command only when asksRemaining > 0.

name: agent.command runner: detached process group + soft failure
description: runAgentCommand spawns /bin/sh -c with detached:true and kills -pid on timeout (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after grace), plus a hard resolve fallback in case grandchildren hold pipes. Never throws: failures return {status, error} and think shows a notice and continues with rule questions. Env: ROOTS_AGENT/ROOTS_SESSION/ROOTS_NODE set, ROOTS_USER removed; human commands that widen agent power (tier) refuse when ROOTS_AGENT is set (guard.refuseAgentSession).

title: Agent file writes go through boundary.ts
rationale: sprout/note write only via agentWriteExclusive(): lexical check (inside .roots/agent, not human/), lstat every component for symlinks, realpath of deepest existing ancestor, then O_EXCL create. Names are rebuilt from slugified parts so input never steers the path. Stage-6 guard/verify can reuse isHumanPath().

title: Sprout expiry stored on node; adopt is one graph lock
rationale: Sprouts store expiresAt at creation (config TTL changes do not move deadlines) and expire lazily like proposals (sproutView for reads). Adopt composes in a temp file first so cancel leaves nothing, then creates idea + derives edge (insertEdge allowDerives) + sprout adopted in one updateGraph; failures rm the new dir.

content: Claude Code PreToolUse deny = stdout JSON {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason}} with exit 0; allow = no output, exit 0. Hooks schema nests handlers in matcher groups.

title: roots drift is hook-safe and never writes
rationale: Runs from the tier-3 Stop hook: outside a project, below project tier 3, git failure or any read error -> exit 0 with no stdout (--json gives skipped reason). Uses findProjectRoot+readGraph, not openWorkspace, because openWorkspace's dir-rename fix-up writes. Tool data dirs (.roots/.seeds/.mulch/.canopy) are excluded from changed files.

title: Moot proposals expire like overdue ones
rationale: Consistent with existing lazy TTL expiry; no new event type; tend never offers undecidable cards.
